notes: Built 2026-11-12 from https://www.drvc.org/mass-times/ (WordPress page 15718, modified 2026-10-21): one entry per church heading under a town heading, with its linked website and schedule text. Omits the Fire Island chapels and Lakeview mission; lists St. Vincent de Paul Elmont, now the Syro-Malankara cathedral. The trailing Traditional Latin Mass list is not imported. group empty: no grouping. Script: scratch/rockville-centre-map-1/tools/masstimes.py.
